chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Abd al-Rahman, from Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who arrives in Mecca while the heat has become intense upon him, so he performs tawaf around the Ka'bah and delays the sa'y until it becomes cooler. He said: There is no problem with it, and sometimes I have done it. He said: And sometimes I saw him delaying the sa'y until the night.

key_terms.السَّعْيَ: the ritual walking between al-Safa and al-Marwah
key_terms.اللَّيْلِ: the night, as a later time for performing the sa'y
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it; it is permissible
key_terms.يَطُوفُ: he performs tawaf around the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to delay the sa'y after tawaf in Mecca due to severe heat?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person arrives in Mecca and the heat is severe, he may perform tawaf first and delay the sa'y until the weather becomes cooler. Imam Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام declares this permissible and mentions that this was at times practiced as well.
